subject: Demo scheduling: Redwood Inference standard tenant + routing/fallback walkthrough
body:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Chen <maya.chen@pineconerobotics.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 4, 2025 at 5:12 PM PST
Subject: Demo scheduling: Redwood Inference standard tenant + routing/fallback walkthrough

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, we can walk you through a live demo using our standard (sanitized) demo tenant — focused on latency/cost controls, routing + fallback, and the Console dashboards.

Would one of these windows work for a 30–45 min session?
- Thu 2/6 10:00–11:30am PT
- Thu 2/6 2:00–4:00pm PT
- Fri 2/7 9:00–11:00am PT

Proposed agenda (happy to tailor):
1) 3 min — context + your current inference setup (one question each)
2) 10 min — streaming chat / structured outputs (known-good scenario)
3) 10 min — routing + fallback policies (capacity/risk control)
4) 10 min — cost + latency breakdown in Console + saved views
5) 5–10 min — Q&A + next steps (trial vs dedicated vs private)

Pre-read (optional, 2 pages): Redwood Standard Demo One-Pager
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1RwdDemoOnePagerV1/view?usp=sharing

If it’s easier, you can also grab a slot via Calendly here (same availability):
https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/standard-demo

Best,
Avery

Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0184


---

From: Maya Chen <maya.chen@pineconerobotics.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@pineconerobotics.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 5, 2025 at 8:03 AM PST
Subject: Re: Demo scheduling: Redwood Inference standard tenant + routing/fallback walkthrough

Hi Avery,

Thursday 2/6 at 10:30am PT works on our side.

Looping in Raj (platform) as well — he’ll be joining and will probably have a few questions on routing + fallbacks.

Thanks,
Maya


---

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Chen <maya.chen@pineconerobotics.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@pineconerobotics.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 5, 2025 at 9:21 AM PST
Subject: Re: Demo scheduling: Redwood Inference standard tenant + routing/fallback walkthrough

Perfect — I’ll send a calendar invite for Thu 2/6 @ 10:30–11:15am PT.

A couple quick notes so the live demo is smooth:
- No install needed (we’ll drive screens + run a few scripted API calls).
- We’ll use our demo tenant with canned prompts/outputs where it matters to avoid nondeterminism.
- If you have a specific “must show” (e.g., throttling behavior, multi-region, version pinning), reply here and we’ll adjust.

Invite coming shortly.

Best,
Avery


---

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Chen <maya.chen@pineconerobotics.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@pineconerobotics.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 5, 2025 at 9:28 AM PST
Subject: Re: Demo scheduling: Redwood Inference standard tenant + routing/fallback walkthrough

Hi Maya, hi Raj — looking forward to it.

To make the routing/fallback section relevant, can you share (even at a high level) what you’re optimizing for right now?
Common patterns we can map to:
- “Lowest latency under p95 SLO” with a cost guardrail
- “Predictable throughput” (reserved capacity) + graceful degradation
- “One model pinned, fallback to compatible variant if capacity constrained”

Also, here’s the same pre-read Avery shared (2 pages). It’s optional but it covers the terminology we use in the Console:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1RwdDemoOnePagerV1/view?usp=sharing

Thanks,
Markus

Markus Klein
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference


---

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@pineconerobotics.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Chen <maya.chen@pineconerobotics.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 5, 2025 at 10:02 AM PST
Subject: Re: Demo scheduling: Redwood Inference standard tenant + routing/fallback walkthrough

Hi Markus,

Thanks — our biggest issue right now is performance variance when traffic spikes.

If you can cover:
1) How fallback works when primary is saturated (and what the app sees)
2) How you surface the “why” in dashboards (throttles vs 5xx vs timeouts)
3) Whether the same policies carry to dedicated capacity later

That would be great.

See you tomorrow.

Raj


---

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@pineconerobotics.com>, Maya Chen <maya.chen@pineconerobotics.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 7, 2025 at 11:26 AM PST
Subject: Re: Demo scheduling: Redwood Inference standard tenant + routing/fallback walkthrough

Raj/Maya — great meeting yesterday. Thanks again for the detailed questions.

Per your asks, here are the follow-ups we committed to:
- A short write-up on how the client experiences fallback (HTTP/SDK behavior + what headers we return)
- Screenshots of the Console panels we used for “saturation vs errors vs throttles”
- A quick comparison of which routing policies are identical across Hosted vs Dedicated (and what changes)

Also, here’s the pre-read again in case you want to share internally:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1RwdDemoOnePagerV1/view?usp=sharing

Next step suggestion: if you’re open to it, we can do a 30-min technical deep dive next week focused on your traffic shape + candidate policy (primary + fallback) and what it would look like on Dedicated.

If you send 2–3 windows, we’ll get it on the calendar.

Best,
Avery

Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0184
